title: Cascade Cavern and Old San Antonio Road

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located at 215 Old San Antonio Road on the northeast corner of Cascade Cavern and Old San Antonio Road, approximately one-half block off I.H. 10.

rows.label: Utilities
pairs: Along frontage of Old San Antonio Road and Cascade Cavern
Along frontage of Old San Antonio Road and Cascade Cavern
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility and available capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses with the City of Boerne.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025 and 2030.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: 2024 Texas Highway Traffic Count Map indicates 51,749 vehicles per day on I.H. 10 just north of its intersection with Cascade Caverns Road.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: Federal Emergency Management Agency Maps do not appear to indicate any 100-year-flood plain on the tract.

rows.label: Topography
rows.text: The property has a gentle slope to the east.

rows.label: Easements
rows.text: There is a drainage easement along the rear of the property.

rows.label: Deed Restrictions
rows.text: There is a deed restriction against hotel / hospitality for fifty years beginning in 2007.

comments: Exceptional growth area driving the need for additional commercial services.
Excellent visibility and accessibility to I.H. 10
A 12 screen Starplex Cinema is on the north border of the property.
A Marriott Fairfield Inn is on the east border of the property.
The I.H. 10 intersection area has a variety of commercial development including a Valero Store and 4 auto dealerships.

qa_notes: PRICE MISMATCH: PDF Investment row gives '$ 3,928,711.00; $18.00 per square foot'; Prismic total_price is 'Contact Broker' (price_per_unit null). Confirm which is current before publishing either.
PRICE ARITHMETIC: 5.0106 ac x 43,560 = 218,261.7 sf x $18.00 = $3,928,711 (matches). Using the survey's rounded 218,262 sf gives $3,928,716 - a $5 difference, immaterial.
TITLE MISMATCH: PDF cover prints 'CASCADE CAVERN AND OLD SAN ANTONIO ROAD'; Prismic title is 'Cascade Caverns at Old San Antonio Road'. Transcribed from the PDF.

NAME SPELLING inconsistent within the PDF: 'Cascade Cavern' (cover, Location, Utilities) vs 'Cascade Caverns' (Dimensions, Traffic Count 'Cascade Caverns Road', Demographic Overview title, survey). Kept as printed each time.

COVER MAPPING: cover reads '5.01 ACRES IN BOERNE, TEXAS / CASCADE CAVERN AND OLD SAN ANTONIO ROAD / ON I.H. 10 CORRIDOR'. The first line is split into size_headline '5.01 Acres' + city 'Boerne, Texas', and the tagline 'On I.H. 10 Corridor' (printed below the address line) is used as eyebrow so no cover text is lost. Re-typesetter may prefer eyebrow '5.01 Acres in Boerne, Texas' instead.
SIZE: cover and spec '5.01 Acres'; survey '5.0106 ACRES (218,262 SQUARE FEET)'; Prismic size_label '5.0106 acres' / acres 5.0106 (consistent).

DIMENSIONS row: Frontage has two sub-lines (Old San Antonio Road: 535 Feet / Cascade Caverns: 214 Feet); encoded as pairs with the second pair's label '' (continuation of Frontage), then Depth. Survey confirms 535' and 214'.
ZONING: PDF 'C-3, City of Boerne' matches Prismic.
Spec demographics table matches the Demographic Overview (3/5/7-mile: 21,907 / 48,144 / 72,175; $157,167 / $165,183 / $171,793). Overview owner+renter columns sum exactly to 2025 Households.
No fax number is printed on this package's contact line (phone only).
Aerial maps (pp5-6) show a stale broker address '18618 Tuscany Stone, Suite 200, San Antonio, TX 78258'; the disclosure page uses '17721 Rogers Ranch Pkwy., Suite 125'.
Prismic highlights ('Excellent commercial corner', 'Strong IH 10 access and visibility') are paraphrases and do not appear verbatim in the PDF.
Page footer disclaimer on pp1-2 misspells 'represetation'; template-wide, not transcribed.
